description: DLA is working on a large buy for a Dehumidifier - NSN: 4440016994396. We are issuing a request for proposal for a Large Buy for an indefinite quantity of 71 EA with a 50% and 100% quantity option. The Dehumidifier is manufactured by Munters Corporation, CAGE: 82974, under part number: GC-150 30116A. This solicitation will be issued using FAR 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The anticipated solicitation date is 5/8/2026. For inquiries, please contact Timmy Kitzinger at Timothy.Kitzinger@DLA.mil.
